'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Conrad Simmering LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Conrad Simmering]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Username:''' Maul12555
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
